name: DotSkills
_comment: DotSkills repository registry: this file lists first-level skill packages and machine-readable metadata used by repository tooling and validation.

A skill with exposed=false remains registered in DotSkills for repository integrity but should be treated as hidden/not ready for harness packaging or public discovery. Skills without exposed=false are eligible to be exposed.

This file does not itself install, execute, expose, or inject skills into ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, or any other harness. Harness-specific adapters or install/package steps decide what is actually made available.

The repository validator expects every skills/<name>/ directory to have a matching catalog entry, and every catalog entry to point to an existing skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Add, rename, or remove catalog entries when the corresponding skill package changes.

skills.name: apply-dfrde
skills.purpose: Domain-agnostic, design-first and review-driven engineering lifecycle for skills, tools, agents, harnesses, applications and infrastructure: discover, design, contract, implement, evaluate, and release with human gates and evidence.

skills.name: evaluate-skill
skills.purpose: Optional evidence-driven, conference-informed, human-gated workflow for learning, evaluating, and refining agent skills, with diagnosis-first specialist routing and regression checks.

skills.name: audit-skill
skills.purpose: Unified read-only evidence-backed review of one or more skills (contracts, Agent Skills compliance, quality, trust, Mermaid workflows, evaluation gaps and portability), plus DFRDE Stages 1–3 prefill: source-backed Discovery, proposed Design options and conditional Contract drafts pending human approval.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.purpose: Diagnose and improve how a target skill selects, verifies, expands, and stops using context.

skills.name: correctness-and-verification
skills.purpose: Turn requirements into verifiable claims, invariants, checks, and evidence-backed conclusions.

skills.name: skill-lifecycle-and-release
skills.purpose: Version, compare, regression-test, review, and release skill changes safely across model and harness changes.

skills.name: agent-observability-and-feedback
skills.purpose: Instrument agent journeys, inspect traces and outcomes, and turn production feedback into actionable eval coverage.

skills.name: agent-trust-and-governance
skills.purpose: Apply provenance, authority boundaries, approvals, risk controls, and verification to agent context and actions.

skills.name: code-review
skills.purpose: Engineering code review through individual book lenses.

skills.name: review-implementation
skills.purpose: Guided post-implementation self-review of AI-generated or human-authored changes: inspect diff and requirements, understand flows, challenge failure modes through SDI, verify actual test evidence, and report pre-merge readiness gaps.

skills.name: refine-requirements
skills.purpose: Codebase-first, recommendation-first collaborative engineering design: four SDI steps, refined FR/NFRs, architecture options, explicit technical decision and overall design approvals, and an implementation-ready handoff only after user sign-off.

skills.name: reazn
skills.purpose: One-pass, read-only, input-agnostic four-step SDI reasoning for bounded existing-system understanding, change assessment or new design. Resolve assessment intent, distinguish source requirements from observed implementation, audit suggestions and unknowns, preserve stable provenance, and optionally add learn: on chapter references.

skills.name: slice
skills.purpose: Read-only, tracker-agnostic decomposition of approved feature requirements or SDI handoffs into the minimum independently verifiable stories, subtasks and optional parent, with acceptance criteria, evidence traceability, dependencies and explicit unresolved decisions.

skills.name: refine-documentation
skills.purpose: Minimal editorial cleanup for existing documents: remove repetition and filler, use plain English, and preserve unique information, structure, status, decisions, and links without generating new content.

skills.name: learn-repo
skills.purpose: Read-only, overview-first repository learning menu: all material evidence-anchored questions first, followed by learner-selected Guided/Practice deep dives across three stages and five book lenses.

skills.name: learn-implementation
skills.purpose: Read-only, implementation-first learning: a skimmable four-step SDI overview of observed code/flows with boxed ASCII architecture, evidence-backed trade-offs, conditional performance recommendations, verified chapter pointers from six books (including AI Agents in Action, 2nd ed.), and optional Guided/Practice deep dives.

skills.name: study-mcpa
skills.purpose: Interactive, overview-first MCPA certification tutor with guided lessons, exam practice, progress review, and optional secure DotSkills MCP Server labs up to Fly.io deployment.

skills.name: track-working-groups
skills.purpose: Track and organize working groups with stable IDs, private local state, public GitHub update detection, source-linked briefings, meeting preparation, and imported notes.

skills.name: buffr-decision-support
skills.purpose: Buffr M0–M7 module reference and execution guidance; engine remains external.
